findings.text: the sentence states both gate recaptures carry the revision, the tree, the working-tree status and the resolved module path on their first lines, but wait-shape-gate-at-merged-head.log lines 1-4 carry run, revision, tree and resolved_module and no status line, while the sibling watcher-unit-gate-at-merged-head.log:2 does carry one, so the plan text describes a provenance element this artefact does not hold and a reader comparing the two logs is told to expect the same header shape from both.

the landed record names the log, its path and its digest but not the command that produced its figure, so a reader cannot reproduce "17 passed, 0 failed" from the record alone and must recover the command from a manifest the plan's own section 17 says may be gone; the sibling surface states the same class of defect as the fourth reviewer finding, so one command line in the anchor closes it.

item_verdicts.diff: read against base 45e9a6c0; the single commit ab4cef06 adds a 19-line anchored block to docs/evidence/archive/crew-runtime-positive-controls-landed.html:1276, a 3-line r-comment to docs/plans/crew-runtime-positive-controls.html:1101 and the 31-line baseline log, and carries no production code, so the landed change is documentation plus two captured runs and nothing else.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when asks for one captured run of tests/test_wait_shapes.py at the current main revision whose provenance header names the revision and the resolved module path, with the pass count and an EXIT line last; wait-shape-gate-at-merged-head.log holds exactly one session (one "test session starts" and one "passed" line), its header at lines 2 and 4 names revision f957e3f8 and the main checkout's recovery.py, and lines 30-31 read "17 passed" and "EXIT=0"; the brief's expected 11 is the file's function count, verified as 11 "def test_" lines in tests/test_wait_shapes.py with three of them parametrized over SHAPE_IDS of three shapes, and the evidence record's own pre-existing sentence at docs/evidence/archive/crew-runtime-positive-controls-landed.html:1301 already states 17 for the file alone, so the deviation is the brief's unit rather than the run's result and the worker reported it rather than retrying the run into a literal match.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is to re-run the wait-shape focused gate at the integrated head and capture its log, because the only log kept was the wider population run carrying a pre-existing failure; /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/reports/reckon/wait-shape-gate-at-merged-head.log lines 1-4 run tests/test_wait_shapes.py at revision f957e3f8 with tree /home/ITER/mcintos/Code/reckon and resolved_module /home/ITER/mcintos/Code/reckon/reckon/crew/recovery.py, and I verified git diff 45e9a6c0 main -- tests/test_wait_shapes.py reckon/crew/recovery.py is empty at main 6dc80c5d and the main checkout's editable pointer still names /home/ITER/mcintos/Code/reckon, so the recapture measures the integrated code from the main tree rather than from a worktree copy.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; manifest.md:11 records commit ab4cef06, manifest.md:14 records the deliverable log's sha256 56c22594e32d6d3f8b8a3de11848f48066a2e1e379a23d21f1977c462d121b90 which matches the file on disk, manifest.md:17 gives the paired base run at 45e9a6c0 with digest 8d3610d4 which matches the committed docs/figures/crew-runtime-positive-controls/wait-shape-baseline-at-base.log reporting 17 passed EXIT=0 at base, and manifest.md:21 states the count reconciliation and the base-vs-head attribution rather than claiming a pass it cannot support.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the four declared paths are the reports log, the evidence archive, the figures directory and the plan; git show --stat ab4cef06 lists exactly docs/evidence/archive/crew-runtime-positive-controls-landed.html, docs/figures/crew-runtime-positive-controls/wait-shape-baseline-at-base.log and docs/plans/crew-runtime-positive-controls.html, every one inside the fence and none of them the plan's plan-version or plan-modified meta lines, which the three-line plan diff confirms.

justifications.durability: the count's durability rests on the committed baseline log and on tests/test_wait_shapes.py, which is what reddens if the reader regresses, but nothing reddens if the new anchor at docs/evidence/archive/crew-runtime-positive-controls-landed.html:1276 or the revision it names drifts.
justifications.evidence: the log is a single unedited run kept outside the run directory and indexed by digest in manifest.md:14, the paired base log is committed at docs/figures/crew-runtime-positive-controls/wait-shape-baseline-at-base.log, and the count is reconciled against the plan's own figure at docs/evidence/archive/crew-runtime-positive-controls-landed.html:1301, but neither the log nor the landed record carries the command that produced the figure.
justifications.fit: the header form and trailing EXIT line at wait-shape-gate-at-merged-head.log:1-4 and :31 match the convention the plan states at docs/plans/crew-runtime-positive-controls.html:882, but the header carries three of the four elements that sentence names, since the sibling watcher-unit-gate-at-merged-head.log:2 carries a status line and this one has none.
justifications.goal_fidelity: wait-shape-gate-at-merged-head.log:2 files the run under f957e3f8, which is an ancestor of main rather than the head at capture time, so the "current main revision" clause holds by byte-identity (git diff 45e9a6c0 main -- tests/test_wait_shapes.py reckon/crew/recovery.py is empty) plus the log's resolved_module line rather than by the log's own provenance alone.
justifications.scope_discipline: the commit's three repository paths all sit inside the four declared write paths, the plan addition at docs/plans/crew-runtime-positive-controls.html:1101 touches no meta line, and the run's worktree is clean with exactly that one commit.
